Getting Started

Welcome to the Portfolio Evaluator! Here's how to get started:

  1. Import Your Portfolio - Upload your investment transaction data or holdings summary.
  2. View Your Portfolio - See a breakdown of your investments by category, sector, and asset class.
  3. Analyze Performance - Evaluate your portfolio's performance with advanced metrics.
